host: x86_64 dev box, Mesa llvmpipe (LLVM 15.0.6, 256 bits), Vulkan 1.3.230, software driver only; no Apple silicon touched, M1 GPU lock untouched
summary: Named capability-simulation profiles (MLX_OMARCHY_CAPS_SIM) overriding the discovered capability report so non-M1 capability axes develop and regression-test without the hardware; explicit, stamped, evidence-free, and backed-or-refused.

axes: driver_variant (never simulated; profiles record which driver_variant they represent)
memory_model (C++ fields unified_memory + host_visible_coherent; inherit-only in shipped profiles)
digest_policy (per_driver_build; enforced by refusing all digest/bench evidence under simulation)

measured_host_facts.consequence: any 32-lane subgroup claim over this host cannot be executed faithfully: subgroupAdd and shuffle-down kernels assume physical == logical 32 lanes; the harness refuses them by name instead of silently mis-summing

profiles.name: m1-honeykrisp-fork
profiles.exercises: M1-fork dispatch decisions: QmmVecSubgroup/QmmVecQ4WordSubgroup gate ON, MatmulVecBF16 gate ON, Matmul/QmmPrefillCoopmat selection ON, SdpaDecodeNative gate ON
profiles.llvmpipe_outcome: all five gated kernels refuse by name (hardware cannot back 32-lane physical subgroups or the coopmat extension); refusals name profile, kernel, and axis

profiles.name: m1-stock-no-coopmat
profiles.exercises: today's stock-M1 routes: subgroup gates flip the decode kernels on, coopmat gates off -> tile/composed fallbacks
profiles.llvmpipe_outcome: subgroup kernels refuse by name; dense matmul 16x16 tile, QmmTileRbF16 prefill, composed f16 SDPA all correct within documented envelopes

profiles.name: subgroup-size-64
profiles.exercises: every ==32 gate falling back on width alone: qmm vec subgroup OFF, BF16 GEMV shuffle OFF, SDPA native OFF
profiles.llvmpipe_outcome: q4 GEMV bound 0.0462, BF16 GEMV max_abs_err 0.0367 <= bound 0.1631, tile + composed SDPA correct; zero refusals

profiles.name: small-shared-memory
profiles.exercises: the shared-memory axis in isolation: 21504-byte SdpaDecodeNative staging gate flips OFF, 4096-byte coopmat gates stay satisfied
profiles.llvmpipe_outcome: SDPA decode routes to composed f16 SDPA (correct); coopmat kernels still refuse by name; single-axis delta over m1-fork confirmed

profiles.name: no-cooperative-matrix
profiles.exercises: op-mask axis (subgroup_ops_mask) independent of width: qmm subgroup and BF16 GEMV gates fall back on missing feature bits alone

test_results.runner: omarchy_capability_sim_tests (doctest), one invocation per profile, MLX_OMARCHY_ALLOW_NON_APPLE=1
cases: unit (no device): unknown profile refuses by name listing every registered profile; registry complete; apply() delta mapping per audit axis

capability report is stamped with the active profile (simulated=true, profile name, driver_variant; hardware report unstamped and identical device identity; device_info carries simulated/simulation_profile keys)
q4 g64 decode gemv matches the f64 host reference
dense bf16 decode gemv matches the f64 bound
coopmat f32 matmul routes per the profile
f16 q4 g64 prefill routes per the profile
sdpa decode routes per the profile

per_profile.m1-honeykrisp-fork: 6/6 pass (3 named refusals asserted, 2 named refusals for subgroup kernels asserted, stamp case)

test_results.silent_path_change_policy: no test accepts a silently different numeric path: every gated kernel either matches its documented accuracy envelope through the gate-chosen route or refuses by name. On this host the 32-lane-subgroup kernels CANNOT execute faithfully (physical 8-lane subgroups), so those legs assert the named refusal and remain owned by real 32-lane hardware (the M1 leg)

spir_v.method: omarchy_shaders target built from pristine origin/main 21710dfb worktree and from this branch with the identical pinned toolchain (glslang); sha256 of every .spv compared
spir_v.result: 416/416 shaders byte-for-byte identical (hash lists equal: sha256 6a7950a4e4bec49b851865fd79ce34539da9915587a056a8f90e1fa50b68b46b for both sorted hash lists)
spir_v.claim: the compiled kernels this change ships are the kernels main ships

device_report.method: mlx-omarchy-info --json with no MLX_OMARCHY_CAPS_SIM on both builds, same llvmpipe host
device_report.result: byte-identical output; the simulated/simulation_profile/simulated_driver_variant keys are emitted only when a profile is active

dispatch_path.method: source delta: the only dispatch-path additions are omarchy::capsim::require_backed calls that return immediately when caps.simulated is false (always false without the env var); VkDevice creation reads hardware_caps_ which equals the discovered report without simulation; no ComputeKernel enum value changed (GPU-profile stream ids stable); no gate expression rewritten
dispatch_path.claim: with the env var unset the dispatch decisions are the same decisions main makes on the same report

evidence_refusals.backend_stamp: simulated CapabilityReport stamps device_info() and mlx-omarchy-info (json + text) with simulated/simulation_profile/simulated_driver_variant; init prints a three-line stderr banner
evidence_refusals.scripts: scripts/caps_sim_guard.py wired into scripts/bench_decode.py and scripts/bench_matrix.py (exit 3, named refusal) and scripts/sdpa-ab.sh; bench_decode_identity.py inherits the refusal through bench_decode and its device_info dump carries the stamp
evidence_refusals.tests: tests/test_capability_sim_guard.py: 2/2 pass (refusal exit code, profile name in stderr)

constraints_honored.kernel_arithmetic: no shader or kernel arithmetic touched (SPIR-V 416/416 identical)
constraints_honored.digest_pins: six canonical Q4 digests and per-driver BF16 pins untouched; simulation refuses to produce any digest evidence
constraints_honored.m1_gpu_lock: not taken; all work on llvmpipe
constraints_honored.default_build: byte-identical shaders, byte-identical no-sim device report

known_limits: the numeric proof of the 32-lane subgroup kernels (QmmVec*Subgroup*, MatmulVecBF16, SdpaDecodeNative) stays on the M1 leg; software hosts cannot execute them faithfully and the harness now says so by name
cooperative-matrix kernels cannot execute on any software driver; profiles claiming them assert the named refusal here and the real numbers on the honeykrisp-fork hardware leg
memory_model and workgroup_limits axes are inherit-only in the five shipped profiles; the schema supports overrides when a chip needs them
